categories.no_evidence_sentence: No retrieved sentence reached the coverage threshold: the source states the fact tersely or symbolically (for example 'Taps ≤ 10'), so the claim's wording does not overlap enough.
categories.number_normalisation: A number word or numeral was normalised differently on the two sides (for example the proper name 'Phase One' read as the digit 1).
categories.elliptical_evidence: A sentence covers most of the claim but the claim carries context words that the terse source sentence leaves implicit (it relies on the surrounding passage), so the addition limit rejects it.
